description: MiMo V2.6 Flash MOPD is Xiaomi's updated checkpoint of MiMo V2.6 Flash, a 309B-parameter mixture-of-experts model activating 15B parameters per token. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation extends it to long-horizon tasks and reduces repeated tool calls in agent workflows. It accepts text, supports tool calling, structured output and optional reasoning, and has a 1M-token context window.
name: MiMo V2.6 Flash MOPD
